title: AgentLedger gateway audit event (one JSON object per line)
description: Written by gateway/audit.py. Contract for CloudWatch queries, the Console and the Ledger. Fields not listed may be added; consumers must ignore unknown fields. Never contains tokens, keys, prompts or file contents.

event_id.description: Unique per line, evt_ + 16 hex characters.

event.description: decision = allow/deny before the call; outcome = what happened after; usage = a finished model call; sentinel = a grant lock; identity = ping/whoami.

activity_id.description: act_ + 12 hex. Ties the decision line to its outcome or usage line. A retry gets a new id.

decision.description: Kept as the main filter field for log queries. For outcome and usage lines see status.

status.description: Only on outcome and usage lines.

reason.description: allowed, authenticated, completed, failed, or a denial reason such as branch_not_permitted, grant_revoked, grant_quarantined.

human_id.description: The grant's owner, not necessarily who made the call.

resource.description: repository, branch, path, issue, model, input_tokens, output_tokens. Never file contents.

artifact.description: Outcome lines only. kind is git_commit, git_branch or issue; includes repository, branch, path, sha or number.

evidence.description: external = confirmed by a GitHub response. Absent on failures.

error.description: Failed outcomes only. A safe short message or an exception type name, at most 200 characters.

evidenceLevels.verified: signed identity, grant decision, or an operation observed by the gateway
evidenceLevels.external: a GitHub commit, PR, review or test run confirmed by the GitHub API
evidenceLevels.reported: an agent says it did something; nothing confirmed it
